email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The coal berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete discharge late on 26 Jan. VALDA CREST is next in line, berthing about 27 Jan 0600 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam

result.result:
**Judgement.** The agent's berthing time is provisional — "about 27 Jan 0600 UTC" and "subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned" — so it is not firm. It is nonetheless later than the current port call ETA (25 Jan 21:00 UTC), so slowing down to avoid waiting at anchor is worth considering. On the route, the voyage notes flag heavy weather expected from 22 Jan evening to 24 Jan (wind up to Beaufort 8 astern, seas up to 6.1 m), which is current as the ship stands off the Iberian coast; the Master's safety judgement on that weather comes first.

**Speed advice (voyage optimisation service, simulated figures).** Advised speed 8.3 kn, advised arrival at Rotterdam 27 Jan 04:00 UTC, two hours before the provisional berth; 31 hours at anchor saved; 38.1 t VLSFO saved versus the base speed of 12.4 kn. The speed plan checks out against the sea route (763.6 nm) and arrives before the berth.

**ETA notices.** Per the CP rules, an ETA notice is now due: the ETA has moved 31 hours since the last notice (sent 3 days ago), exceeding the 12-hour limit. The notice goes to the agent and receiver, with the new ETA 27 Jan 04:00 UTC.

**What the operator should decide.** Whether to order the reduced speed of 8.3 kn. If yes: (a) a speed instruction to the Master at 8.3 kn with arrival 27 Jan 04:00 UTC, noting that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first; (b) the ETA notice that check_notices says is due, to the agent and receiver, with the new ETA 27 Jan 04:00 UTC; (c) a voyage management system entry updating the Rotterdam port call ETA to 27 Jan 04:00 UTC. Nothing should be sent until the operator answers.
